name: Indraf by Seester Vis & Chips
address: Brinkleys River Village, 1 Old George Road, R102, Klein Brak River, 6505, South Africa
description_short: Classic fish and chips done right in a riverside village setting between Mossel Bay and George.
description_long:
Tucked into Brinkleys River Village along the Klein Brak River, Indraf by Seester Vis & Chips serves up honest, no-fuss fish and chips that have locals coming back. The focus here is simple: fresh seafood, perfectly crispy batter, and generous portions that won't break the bank.

The riverside location makes it an easy stop whether you're travelling the Garden Route or exploring the Klein Brak area. It's the kind of place where you order at the counter, grab a seat, and tuck into proper fish and chips without any pretense. The casual vibe suits families, travellers, and anyone craving quality takeaway seafood.

With consistently high ratings from locals and visitors alike, Indraf has carved out a reputation for doing the basics exceptionally well. It's straightforward, affordable eating in a pleasant village setting—exactly what a good fish and chip shop should be.
